prompt:
透明背景。Draw ONE NEW complete whole-body arcade pixel sprite of Ultraman Arc LUNA ARMOR walking SCREEN RIGHT. Fixed side-view camera, one person, one animation phase. Image 1 is a pose guide; image 2 is the accepted exact character identity, armor, red/silver suit, proportions and pixel finish. Follow the new absolute pose, not the standing pose of the master.
The WHITE guide chain is the NEAR leg, closer to camera, painted BRIGHT SILVER. The DARK guide chain is the FAR leg, behind in depth, painted DARK SILVER. Keep each continuous hip-knee-ankle chain and its permanent color identity.
REQUIRED WALK PHASE 07: NEAR LEG REACH / FAR SUPPORT: The BRIGHT NEAR leg is reaching toward screen RIGHT with its leading boot slightly ABOVE ground, preparing heel contact in the next phase. The DARK FAR leg trails at screen LEFT and its boot supports the ground. Preserve the complete bright near hip-to-front-knee-to-front-ankle chain and dark far hip-to-rear-knee-to-rear-ankle chain. A narrow forward-reaching stride, not a static wide fighting stance; torso upright over the rear dark support foot as the bright heel reaches ahead.
ARM TRANSITION IS ESSENTIAL: both arms and shoulders move naturally with the hips. The near circular wrist disk is beside the LOWER ribs, with its clenched fist forward at UPPER ABDOMEN height. The far forearm is bent forward with its fist at LOWER CHEST height. Elbows relaxed and bent. This is a MEDIUM-HEIGHT walking guard between a low waist guard and a high close chest guard, neither both hands dangling at hips nor both fists raised at face height. Preserve both connected shoulders/elbows/wrists, without one arm locked rigid.
Keep the same body size and full limb lengths, natural small weight transfer, upright head and coherent shoulder/chest/pelvis motion. Luna identity: low silver swept head crest with its opening, yellow eye, cyan chest lamp, blue moon armor on shoulders/chest, circular cyan wrist disks and continuous red/silver suit. Original armor segmentation, natural continuous suit joints.
Crisp limited 32-color pixel clusters, stepped dark contour, upper-left light. True RGBA transparent PNG, full head, feet, hands and all armor tips within clear margins. No photo, toy ball joints, screws, plastic seams, stand, blur, vector rendering, shadows, text, guide lines, grids, skeleton, extra people, weapons, glow or Q/charge FX. Redraw the entire figure together; no limb cutting, rotating, swapping, mirroring or pasted pieces.
